title: Wedding Budget Calculator
description: Allocate a wedding budget across categories with percentage guides and running totals.
howto: Adjust each category's % of budget (defaults follow common planning guides).
Add or remove categories to match your plans.
Watch the allocated total and remaining budget update live.

faqs.q: Do the percentages have to add to 100?
faqs.a: No, but if they don't, the allocated total will differ from your budget and the tool shows the gap so you can rebalance.
No, they are common planning guides. Every wedding is different; adjust freely.
Unexpected costs. Planners often reserve 5-15% of the budget for overruns.
